St. Paul property tax is billed by the offices named below.

Who bills what in St. Paul

  • Ramsey County Assessor handles assessment.
  • Ramsey County Property Tax Services bills and collects the tax.

Due dates

Real property: first half May 15, second half Oct. 15 (next business day if on a weekend). Manufactured homes Aug. 31 / Nov. 15; agricultural second half Oct. 15 per Ramsey table. Penalties start the day after the due date.. See the official page.

Challenging your assessment

Ramsey County appeal page not opened; Minnesota DOR describes local board (April-May), county board (June) or Tax Court by April 30 of the following year.. See the official page.

Tax rate

We could not confirm the current St. Paul rate on an opened page, so we do not state one.

Local notes

  • Ramsey County Property Tax Services (651-266-2222, Plato Building, 90 Plato Blvd W) takes payments; the county Taxes & Values page was opened but its body text did not render in the extraction.
Behind on St. Paul property tax?

Get My Cash Offer →

St Paul by the numbers

The Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey counts about 307,762 people in St Paul, which makes it the 2nd largest of the 43 mn places we cover. The median value of an owner-occupied home is $280,300, 19% below the median of those 43 places. 53% of occupied homes are owner-occupied and 47% are rented, against a median of 72% owner-occupancy across the mn places. The median home was built in 1952, about 71 years ago, which matters for roofs, plumbing and inspection requests. These numbers describe St Paul as a whole, so a given street can sit well above or below them.

Due dates

Real and personal property: first half due 05/15/2026, second half due 10/15/2026; agricultural second half 11/16/2026; manufactured homes 08/31/2026 and 11/16/2026.. See the official page.

Challenging your assessment

Owners can appeal to the local board of appeal and equalization, then the county board of equalization and Tax Court. Confirm the current deadline on your county assessor page. Confirm with your county.

We could not confirm the current Rochester rate on an opened page, so we do not state one.

Rochester by the numbers

With about 121,638 residents, Rochester is number 3 of the 43 mn places in this guide by population (Census Bureau, 2019-2023). Census respondents put the median owner-occupied home in Rochester at $287,500, 17% below the mn median for these places. Renters live in about 35% of Rochester homes, and owners in 65%, where the mn median is 72% owners. A median build year of 1987 puts the typical Rochester house near 36 years old. These numbers describe Rochester as a whole, so a given street can sit well above or below them.
